items.question: Which UAE government entity offers postal, post box, and courier services to businesses?
items.gold: Emirates Post offers postal (including post box) and courier services.
items.fact: Emirates Post provides postal, post box and courier services

items.question: What type of letter do the local Departments of Economic Development and Chambers of Commerce issue as a business support service in the UAE?
items.gold: NOC letters, also called 'To whom it may concern' letters.
items.fact: Local economic departments issue NOC and 'To whom it may concern' letters
